scene.note: Black and white elevated view of an urban stream channel running through a town.

findings.question: channel_form
findings.evidence: downstream photo: bed is submerged and banks are partially obscured, making the true cross-section impossible to determine

findings.question: bottom_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo: channel bed cannot be seen through the surface reflections

findings.question: bank_type
findings.evidence: downstream photo, both banks: artificial stone and brick retaining walls lining the channel

findings.question: habitats
findings.evidence: downstream photo, mid-ground: water falling over a transversal weir structure creating a drop

findings.question: natural_debris
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no fallen trees, branches, or leaf accumulations visible along the channel

findings.question: water_flow
findings.evidence: downstream photo: still photograph cannot distinguish between slow or stagnant flow in the channel

findings.question: water_aspect
findings.evidence: downstream photo, foreground to midground: the water surface reflects surroundings and appears dark without visible transparency or heavy foam

findings.question: water_withdrawal
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no visible pumps, intake pipes, or abstraction structures

findings.question: barriers
findings.evidence: downstream photo, mid-ground: a weir spans across the full width of the channel

findings.question: draining_pipes
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no visible draining pipes discharging polluted effluents into the channel

findings.question: sewage_discharge
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no visible sewage discharge points or grey sewage outflows

findings.question: construction
findings.evidence: downstream photo: no construction machinery, works, or scaffolding in or alongside the stream

findings.question: impervious_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: multi-storey brick buildings border directly along the bank edge

findings.question: impervious_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right margin: paved road, taxi building, and sidewalk occupy the top of the bank

findings.question: vegetation_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: bank is completely occupied by buildings without plant cover

findings.question: vegetation_type_left
findings.evidence: downstream photo, left margin: no vegetation present

findings.question: vegetation_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right bank: overgrown shrubs and weeds cover the slope between the channel and buildings

findings.question: vegetation_type_right
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right bank: dense woody shrubs dominate the vegetated slope

findings.question: vegetation_cut
findings.evidence: downstream photo, right bank: vegetation appears overgrown with no obvious signs of recent cutting
